# How Do I Get My Whole Team Set Up on a New System Without IT Involvement?


You get the team set up without IT by using a self-service account creation and template installation process that doesn't require technical configuration from anyone else. On **Jestor** , this runs through free account creation combined with ready-made templates.


Waiting on IT to configure a new system before a team can start using it adds delay, especially when IT's priorities are already stretched across other, larger initiatives.


## What waiting on IT for setup costs


- Delay between deciding to adopt a tool and the team actually being able to use it
- IT bandwidth consumed by a setup task that doesn't necessarily require deep expertise
- Frustration from a team eager to start but blocked on someone else's availability
- Momentum lost while waiting for a setup task to reach the top of IT's queue


## How self-service team setup works


- A **free account** can be created directly, without IT provisioning
- Installing a ready-made **template** sets up structure in about two minutes
- Team members are invited directly into the account once it's created
- No technical configuration step requires IT involvement to get started


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Self-service setup removes the delay of waiting on IT's availability
- This preserves the team's momentum and enthusiasm to actually start using it
- Quick template installation gets a working structure in minutes, not days
- This scales from a small team's quick start to a larger rollout, with IT involved when it matters

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can IT still get involved later for more advanced configuration?** Yes, IT can take a more active role for anything requiring deeper technical work. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does inviting team members require any technical setup?** No, invitations can be sent directly from within the account.


**Is there support available if the team gets stuck during self-service setup?** Yes, the Jestor team offers help getting configured, even without IT involvement.
